sentences.text: The One Nation One Ration Card scheme aims to provide food security to migrant workers and their families.
It ensures that beneficiaries can access subsidized food grains from any fair price shop in the country.
The objective is to eliminate hunger and malnutrition among the poor and ensure food security for all.
Beneficiaries can avail of subsidized food grains such as wheat and rice.
The scheme is targeted at all National Food Security Act beneficiaries.
Eligible individuals must possess a ration card that is linked to the Aadhaar number.
The application process involves linking the ration card to the Aadhaar number and ensuring it is registered in the state.
The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Consumer Affairs Food and Public Distribution.
It was launched in August 2020 and is being rolled out in phases across the country.
The scheme aims to cover all states and Union Territories by 2023.
